title: What Does a Skill Vocabulary Cost? A Closed-Loop Decomposition over Demonstrated Motions
abstract: arXiv:2611.32858v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete skill policies execute motions drawn from a finite vocabulary. In most current methods, this vocabulary is a latent codebook learned jointly with a selector and a decoder. When such a policy fails in closed loop, the failure cannot be traced to the vocabulary, to the choice of skill or to its execution. We present Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), which places a library of demonstrated motions after a trained policy instead of inside it. MPQ replaces each predicted action chunk with its nearest library element, corrects that element toward the prediction within a bound, and trains no parameters. Across six architectures, including a 7B vision-language-action model, the wrapped policy is statistically equivalent to the original. A reference policy executed through the library is therefore a baseline for any selector over the same library. Substituting a selector's components one at a time attributes its shortfall to them.

translated_title: 技能词汇表的代价是什么？基于演示动作的闭环分解
translated_abstract: 离散技能策略执行来自有限词汇表的动作。在目前的大多数方法中，这个词汇表是与选择器和解码器联合学习的潜在码本。当这样的策略在闭环中失败时，无法将失败归因于词汇表本身、技能的选择或其执行过程。我们提出了运动原型量化，它将一个由演示动作组成的库放置在已训练好的策略之后，而不是嵌入策略内部。MPQ将每个预测的动作块替换为库中最近的元素，并在一定界限内将该元素向预测方向校正，且不需要训练任何参数。在包括7B视觉-语言-动作模型在内的六种架构上，经过包装的策略与原始策略在统计上是等价的。因此，通过该动作库执行的参考策略可以作为同一库上任何选择器的基线。通过逐一替换选择器的组件，可以将其性能差距归因于具体的组件。
tldr: 提出运动原型量化（MPQ），将演示动作库置于已训练策略之后且无需训练参数，使包装后的策略与原策略统计等价，从而建立参考基线，可逐一归因闭环失败于选择器的具体组件。
en_tdlr: Proposes Movement Prototype Quantization (MPQ), which places a library of demonstrated motions after a trained policy without any parameter training, yielding a statistically equivalent wrapped policy that serves as a reference baseline to attribute closed-loop failures to specific selector components.
